title: Vatha Kuzhambu
description: A thick, tangy tamarind curry cooked in sesame oil with a golden dal tempering and onions.

steps.title: Prep tamarind
steps.text: Soak the tamarind with 1 teaspoon of rock salt in water and extract the tamarind juice.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: Heat 6 tablespoons of sesame oil in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add mustard seeds, split chana dal, toor dal, urad dal, fenugreek seeds, asafoetida and dried red chillies. Sauté until the dals turn golden brown.

steps.title: Sauté onions
steps.text: Add the chopped onions and curry leaves. Sauté until the onions are well cooked.

steps.title: Add spices
steps.text: Mix in 2 tablespoons of sambhar powder and the jaggery.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Pour in the extracted tamarind water.

steps.title: Thicken & finish
steps.text: Let the curry boil and reduce until thick, then turn off the stove.

tips: If it doesn't thicken enough, stir in 1 tsp of rice flour dissolved in a little water.
